title: YE HUSSAIN MAQTAL SE KISKI LAASH LAATE HAIN
body:
Kyu'n gulo'n ki khushbu se sara ran mehekta hai
Pairahan mu'attar hai kya ye koi Doolha hai
Chaand sa Hasee'n Chehra dhoop me chamakta hai
Aur lahu ki dhaaron ka Uske Rukh pa sehra hai
<<MINI>>
Ye Hussain maqtal se kiski LaashLaate hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab lagaai thi mehendi us ko Pyaari Behna ne
Maa libaaseNao lekar aayi usko pehnaane
Sab baraation ke the aansuon ke nazraane
Sub'ha kithi ye baatein shaam ki Khuda jaane
<<MINI>>
Ye Hussain maqtal se kiski Laash Laate hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Tashnagi ke sehra me aag si barasti hai
Boondh boondh paani ko zindagi tarasti hai
Tashna kaam Dulha hai aur Dulhan bhi pyaasi hai
Haay kaisi shaadi hai har taraf udaasi hai
<<MINI>>
Ye Hussain maqtal se kiski Laash Laate hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Sub'ha se kaeeLaashe leke aaye maida'n se
Par ye Laash laane ki Shaan hi niraali hai
Ek aba ke goshe meJiski Laash aajaye
Us ke jisme at'har par guzri kya Khuda Jaane
<<MINI>>
Ye Hussain maqtal se kiski Laash Laate hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Ran meLaashDulha ki khaako khoo'n me ghaltaa'n hai
Waa'n Dulhan ke khaime me hashr jaisa saamaa'n hai
Sar pa khaak daali hai maang Uski veera'n hai
Bain Uske sun sun kar Maa ka dil pareshaa'n hai
<<MINI>>
Ye Hussain maqtal se kiski Laash Laate hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Tha Dulhan ka ye Noha gardishe zamana hai
Tum gaye suwe maqtal ham ko qaid khana hai
Yaad ke sahare hi zindagi bitaana hai
Kaash ham hi mar jaate ye bhi koi jeena hai
<<MINI>>
Ye Hussain maqtal se kiski Laash Laate hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Hogayi Dulhan Bewa Sheh ka Dil tadapta hai
Har nafas wohi manzar chashme nam me rehta hai
Ghash me Umme Farwa hai aur Dulhan ko sakta hai
Ab Raza qayamat hai aasmaa'n larazta hai
<<MINI>>
Ye Hussain maqtal se kiski LaashLaate hain
author: Raza Aafandi
